_comment: 'The next attack action card AND non-attack action card you play this turn get "This card costs {r} less to play for each Runechant you control."' Two separate one-shots, one per card kind. The reduction is DYNAMIC: it counts Runechants when the card is PLAYED, not when the entry is queued -- Runechants are created and spent in between -- so the queue stores the expression raw and resolves it at consumption. Temper is a printed keyword.
